message.content:
The task was to determine, on Apple’s website, whether the Mac mini can be configured with a GPU larger than 16-core.

The screenshot shows Apple’s Mac mini Tech Specs page in the “Configure to Order” section. It lists an option for:

“M5 Pro with 18-core CPU, 20-core GPU, and 16-core Neural Engine”

A 20-core GPU is larger than 16-core, so the answer provided in the Result Response — “Yes” — is supported by the screenshot.

Verdict: SUCCESS
